detail: Playwright: picked Opus, sent a message (reply carries usage), read the context pie label, stopped and restarted the server, reopened the page: selector shows Opus, pie label unchanged. Second message launched the agent with --resume fake-session-1 (same session); scripted reply shown.

After a restart the fake agent answered the resumed launch with 'No conversation found with session ID' + exit 1. The pane showed the new-session answer, no 'not delivered' text, the last launch had no --resume, and the message was replayed without the person re-sending.

Two crashes with a 3-line error: exactly one retry launch happened, pane shows 'Your message was not delivered. Send it again.' and all three error lines. After the agent could start, the next send launched with --resume fake-session-1.

Login error (stderr 'Not logged in' / 'Please run /login', exit 1): one launch only (no retry) and all error lines show, but the pane ends with 'Fix the problem above, then send it again.' (src/chat/crash-rules.ts, fatal branch), not 'Your message was not delivered. Send it again.'

Selected Sonnet first (default is Sonnet + Opus advisor); pie data-level blue. During a running turn the model select is disabled (switch refused, still Sonnet). After the turn, picked the advisor option and it showed. Pie click opened the popover with percentage and 'Clear context'; clear showed no crash text and the next message got an answer. Note: the option label is 'Sonnet + Opus advisor', mapped to the step's 'Sonnet with Opus advisor'.

The chat pane has one conversation per project (src/chat/session.ts, client/app/chat-pane.tsx). No tab strip, chips or per-card conversations exist; no tablist or [data-slot=chat-tabs] appears after sending a message.
No tabs exist in the chat pane, so there is nothing to switch to; tablist/tab lookup finds no element.
No tab chips exist. The single chat shows the crash error in its log, but there is no chip to blink red and no line about a tab in another tab's pane.
A model switch does not show a crash text and the next message gets a reply, but the step reads the tab's chip and no tab strip exists.

Background line (shown for 1 task, gone after an empty list) and the 'merge it' Next: button (click sends it as the person's message, agent replies, button goes) work in the single pane. The step's 'tab counts as running' fails: no tab exists.
